youtube.aciklama: Enlarged vestibular aqueduct (EVA) is one of the most common inner ear differences in children. The loss progresses in steps; minor head trauma is the most frequently reported trigger, and after a drop, hearing often does not fully return to its earlier level. Families should know that hearing needs prompt testing after a drop.
